data.title: Software Engineer Internship
data.details:
Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications.
  • Apply AI tools and technologies to improve development workflows and solve technical problems.
  • Explore and implement AI-powered solutions for real-world use cases.
  • Write clean, efficient, readable, and maintainable code.
  • Analyse technical problems, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions.
  • Debug code, troubleshoot errors, and improve application performance.
  • Work with APIs, databases, and third-party services as required.
  • Research new technologies, frameworks, and AI tools relevant to ongoing projects.
  • Collaborate with team members, communicate progress, and contribute to technical discussions.
  • Test applications, identify issues, and implement improvements based on feedback.
  • Learn new technologies quickly and take ownership of assigned tasks.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Good knowledge of programming fundamentals and at least one programming language, preferably Python or JavaScript.
  • Strong understanding of AI concepts, with an interest in AI/ML, generative AI, or AI-powered application development.
  • Strong problem-solving, logical thinking, and reasoning skills.
  • Ability to analyse problems independently and approach them with a structured mindset.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and the ability to use them effectively for coding, debugging, research, and problem-solving.
  • Basic understanding of data structures, algorithms, APIs, and databases is an advantage.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts, discuss ideas, and communicate challenges clearly.
  • Willingness to learn, take feedback, adapt to new technologies, and work independently in a remote environment.
  • Prior experience through personal projects, internships, hackathons, or AI-related projects is an added advantage.

data.title: Software Engineer Internship
data.details:
About the Company

Plasma Tech is inviting applications for an SDE Intern opportunity designed for candidates who want practical exposure to software development in a collaborative, remote environment. The internship offers an opportunity to learn from real product and engineering work while building a strong foundation in professional software development practices.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with designing, developing, testing, and improving software features under the guidance of experienced team members.
  • Write readable, maintainable code and contribute to debugging, documentation, and code reviews.
  • Work with the engineering team to understand requirements, investigate issues, and deliver assigned tasks on schedule.
  • Participate in team discussions and communicate progress, questions, and technical findings clearly in a remote work environment.

Requirements

  • Suitable for candidates with a minimum of 3 months of relevant experience or hands-on software development exposure.
  • Strong interest in software engineering, problem-solving, and learning modern development practices.
  • Basic understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, debugging, and version control is preferred.
  • Applicants from any industry or academic background may apply if they can demonstrate the required aptitude and commitment.
  • The internship is remote, full-time, paid, and runs for 3 months, with a monthly stipend of ₹1,500–₹2,000.

Successful interns will be expected to take ownership of their learning, collaborate responsibly with the team, and contribute consistently throughout the internship.

data.title: Software Development Engineer Internship
data.details:
Confluent Solutions is actively hiring for the role of Software Development Engineer Intern!

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain responsive user interfaces using React.js, HTML, and CSS.
  • Support the implementation of server-side functionality and application features using Node.js.
  • Contribute to mobile application development activities based on project requirements.
  • Assist in improving website performance through analysis, optimization, and implementation of recommended enhancements.
  • Support SEO keyword optimization efforts for digital content and web pages.
  • Explore and contribute to the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in relevant software development initiatives.
  • Create and refine visual assets or supporting design materials using Canva when required.
  • Participate in testing, debugging, issue resolution, and quality improvements across assigned projects.
  • Collaborate with team members, communicate progress, and document relevant development updates.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bring practical interest in building modern digital experiences with React.js, Node.js, HTML, and CSS.
  • Demonstrate enthusiasm for Mobile Application Development, Website Performance Optimization, and SEO Keyword Optimization.
  • Show creative and future-focused thinking through Canva and Artificial Intelligence (AI).

Job Summary:

This 2-month internship at Confluent Solutions offers an engaging opportunity to work on software development initiatives spanning web applications, mobile experiences, performance optimization, SEO, creative content, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). While the location has not been specified, the role includes Hybrid Working and is designed to support both professional and personal growth through a Learning Allowance and Counselling Support. Successful interns may benefit from a Job Offer or Pre-Placement Offer, along with a Certificate of Completion and Letter of Recommendation, making this a valuable launchpad for a career in software development.

data.title: Software Developer Internship
data.details:
About the Company

SLONIX SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED is seeking motivated technology talent to join its software development team. This internship offers final-year students the opportunity to gain practical exposure to product development, engineering collaboration, and professional software delivery in a fast-paced work environment.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications.
  • Translate functional requirements into clean, reliable, and maintainable code.
  • Work with developers and other stakeholders to investigate issues and deliver improvements.
  • Participate in code reviews, documentation, debugging, and technical discussions.
  • Learn and follow engineering practices related to version control, testing, security, and deployment.

Requirements

  • Final-year student & Pre-final year pursuing a relevant degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Good understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving ability, willingness to learn, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a team.
  • Availability for a full-time, 3-month, in-office internship in Bangalore.

This is a paid internship offering a monthly stipend upto ₹20,000. The selected intern will receive hands-on mentoring and practical experience across the software development lifecycle.

data.title: Software Developer Internship
data.details:
About

Migsak is a Bengaluru software company that builds websites, web apps, mobile apps and automation for businesses. We are a small team, so an intern here works on real client projects and is trusted to take features from an empty repository to production.

We build with AI tools every day. Claude, Cursor, Antigravity and similar tools are part of how we design, write, review and ship code, and we expect you to already work this way.

What You Will Do:

  • Take features or small products from idea to deployment with minimal hand-holding
  • Design clean interfaces and build them as working front-end code
  • Build APIs and backend services, and model the data behind them
  • Use AI coding tools to move fast while understanding and owning every line you ship
  • Share progress in a daily online check-in and demo your work at in-person meetups

What We Are Looking For:

  • You can start on a problem alone without waiting to be told each step
  • You pick up a new framework or tool in days
  • Working knowledge of front end, APIs, backend and databases
  • Enough design sense to make a screen look clean and usable
  • At least one project you built from scratch and deployed yourself

Nice to have: React, Next.js, Flutter, Node.js, FastAPI or PostgreSQL, a public GitHub, or any freelance project experience.

Schedule and Commitment:

  • Remote, at least 4 focused hours every weekday
  • 8 hours available across the weekend
  • Short daily online meeting
  • In-person meetups in Bengaluru, at least twice a month
  • Full commitment for the complete 3 months

Stipend:

The first 3 months are unpaid. A stipend is considered after that, based on the work you ship. You also get an internship certificate and a recommendation based on your work.
